minors.what: Nit: the context chip is a plain `<span aria-label="Attached context">` with no `role`. This is the exact defect class r3 raised for MenuTabStrip's `<div aria-label="Ribbon tabs">` — ARIA's `generic` role prohibits naming, so the label is never exposed and a screen reader announces only the text content, "no context". The MenuTabStrip instance was removed in r4; this twin survived. It is the only remaining aria-label on a role-less element in the shell (footer/aside/nav/main/role=log/role=toolbar/selects/buttons all carry a naming-capable role).
minors.why: Inert markup that reads as a working accessible name to the next author, and it will be copied when the chip grows into a real context list.
minors.fix: Drop the `aria-label`, or when the chip becomes live give it a naming-capable wrapper (`role="status"` for the count, or a `<button>` once it opens the context bundle).

minors.what: Nit: the menu spec still lags the shipped template in the doc the code now cites. 00-overview.md:10 describes Edit as "(Undo / Redo / — / Cut / Copy / Paste)", but the template also ships `delete` and `selectAll` (plus `pasteAndMatchStyle` on darwin). r3's fix updated the 20-ui-wireframes.md tree only. Separately, the wireframes File column (20-ui-wireframes.md:44-49) still ends at "Export as HTML…" while src/main/menu/appMenuTemplate.ts:64-65 appends a separator and `close` (darwin) / `quit`.
minors.why: appMenuTemplate.ts:32 now cites 00-overview.md as the authority for the menu's scope, so the cited line being stale on Edit's contents is worse than ordinary doc drift. Same class as the r3 minor, one document over.
minors.fix: Amend 00-overview.md:10 to "(Undo / Redo / — / Cut / Copy / Paste / Delete / Select All)" and add `├─ ──────────────` + `└─ Exit / Quit  (Close on macOS)` to the wireframes File column.
